title: robot-renderer
abstract: Turn a robot's description into views of it from many angles, so other models can recognise it. This PyTorch3D renderer takes a URDF, meshes, camera intrinsics and a joint configuration and returns multi-view templates with ground-truth poses, depth maps and a visible-surface point cloud. Views are sampled on a Fibonacci sphere, scored by visible surface and rendered in one batched pass.
highlight: Six robots ship built in, and a new one registers from its URDF and a small adapter class.

demos.alt: Rendered templates of the six built-in robots, Franka Panda, Baxter, OWI-535, KUKA LBR Med 7, xArm 7 and Meca500
